_comment: Maintained by Claude — see ../CLAUDE.md 'Dashboard Maintenance' rule. Status values: concept | in-progress | review | ready | archived. Keys in 'mocks' are folder paths relative to products/SafeLMS/ (no trailing /index.html).

recentChanges.summary: Reframed OSHA reporting as a tab inside the Dashboard menu (next to Completions + Impact Insights) instead of a left-nav item; Dashboard is now the active nav item. Replaced the % Complete column with Modules Complete (X/10 + mini bar). Added a course dropdown that shows each OSHA course separately (plus an All-courses grouped view). Swapped the Top-5 courses bar chart for Action Needed count cards (Not Started→Intervene, Behind Schedule→Nudge, Failed→Retry); each opens a course-filterable bulk-action modal. Added a bottom version switcher: V1 = per-student module progress + quiz-score modal, V2 = expand/collapse inline module quiz-score columns.

Made the completion report table fit the card width with no horizontal scroll: switched to a fixed table layout with proportional column widths, folded External ID into the Learner cell as a sub-line (one fewer column), let header/cell text wrap, made the % Complete bar flex to its column, tightened padding/font, and shortened the failed-row action label to Retry. Column show/hide menu and group colspan re-indexed for the dropped column.

Added a DevExtreme DataGrid feasibility dev-note above the completion report: confirmed the table maps to native dxDataGrid features (grouping + group-count summary, searchPanel, built-in columnChooser, multiple selection with select-all, cellTemplate/command columns for badges, % complete bar, time spent, failure/eligible-to-retry, certificate link, and action button) and flagged the pieces that are NOT grid config (the overview pie/bar = dxPieChart/dxChart; the filter panel, bulk bar, and stepped bulk modal = app-level UI driving the grid via dataSource filter + selection APIs). No infeasible patterns found.

Fixed a load-timing bug where the column show/hide logic read the Vaadin checkboxes before they upgraded, which hid the optional columns on first paint (Time Spent, Last Accessed, Expiration, Failure / Retry, Certificate, External ID). Columns now default to visible and are tracked explicitly, so % Complete and all the date/certificate columns render on load.

Surfaced the brainstorm data points on the OSHA Completion Report table: added a Time Spent column (companion to % Complete) and a Failure / Retry column (failure date + eligible-to-retry = failure + 14-day cooldown, with Attempt N/3). Last Accessed, Expiration and % Complete were already columns. Both new columns are toggleable in the show/hide-columns menu, and the grouped-row colspan + retry modal now read the failure date.

Moved Certificate out of the row actions into its own Certificate column (a View link for passed learners that opens the cert preview). Added learner selection (per-row checkboxes + select-all) and a bulk action bar that shows a per-action breakdown, then a grouped, stepped bulk flow: the selection is split by the action each learner needs and walked one group at a time — Step X of N — Intervene first, then Nudge, then Schedule Retry, each group confirmable or skippable, with a summary toast at the end (passed learners are noted as needing no action).

Tuned the OSHA Completion Report row actions: removed the per-row View action, set Certificate (passed) to a tertiary button and Intervene/Nudge/Schedule Retry to secondary (Intervene/Nudge keep error/warning color modifiers). Made the table column button a working show/hide-columns menu (External ID, % Complete, Last Accessed, Expiration) that keeps the grouped-row colspan in sync.

Added an Action column to the OSHA Completion Report so each learner row carries the action flows by status: Not Started → Intervene, In Progress → Nudge, Passed → Certificate, Failed → Schedule Retry, plus a View learner-detail action on every row. Re-implemented the modals as a vaadin-dialog (recipient block, email/supervisor/in-app options, message text-area, deadline/new-due date pickers, retry cooldown + Attempt N of 3, certificate preview) with a vaadin-notification success toast on confirm.

Filter-panel polish: the Filters re-open control is now a vaadin-button matching the Send Report/Export height (dropped the fixed right-edge tab); the panel starts closed on load; Apply Filters now just applies and closes (no "Filters Applied" feedback); and the open panel stretches full-height to the bottom with the footer moved into the content column so it no longer runs under the panel.

Rebuilt the OSHA dashboard on the Convergence Report Redesign V1 patterns (leveraging VRF, per the OSHA reporting plan) inside the SafeLMS wrapper: SafeLMS left sidebar + blue topbar, with a Completion Status Overview card (pie chart of Passed/In Progress/Not Started/Failed + Top-5 courses bar chart and a date badge), an OSHA Completion Report grouped table (group-by-course rows with expand/collapse, status badges, sort pill, search, % complete, last accessed, expiration), and the V1 right-side report filter panel (date-range dropdown, Select Courses/Users pickers with chips, completion-status checkboxes that filter the table, expiring/near-failure-limit toggles, open/close). Replaces the prior buckets + action-modal version.

Reworked the OSHA Reports view to lean on Vector web components and reflect the OSHA reporting discussion: buttons → vaadin-button (with error/warning color modifiers and a primary Export), the Status dropdown → a VRF-style right-side filter panel (vaadin-radio-group for status + vaadin-select for expiration/activity/progress + vaadin-checkbox-group for failures) mirroring the Convergence/VRF side-right filtering, table row select/select-all → vaadin-checkbox, % Complete → vaadin-progress-bar, a functional search (vaadin-text-field), course picker → vaadin-select, action modals → vaadin-dialog (renderer/footer with vaadin-text-area + vaadin-date-picker), toast → vaadin-notification, and dashboard inner tabs → vaadin-tabs. Added a 'refreshed nightly from ClickSafety' data note and surfaced the 3-failure limit (Attempt N of 3) on failed learners and in Schedule Retry.

Added a Status filter dropdown in the Learner Progress table header (All / Intervene / Nudge / On Track / Done-Pass / Done-Fail, each with a color dot and count) as an alternative to clicking the bucket cards. The dropdown and the bucket cards stay in sync — selecting in either updates both — replacing the old 'Filtered:' chip.

Made the Action Needed buckets and the learner table work together: moved the Learner Progress table directly under the buckets (visualizations now sit below). Added per-row action modals with confirmation — Intervene and Nudge (recipient list, send options, editable message), Schedule Retry (failure date / cooldown / eligible-to-retry + new due date), View (On Track learner detail), and Certificate (completion preview + Download PDF). Added row checkboxes on Intervene/Nudge learners with a select-all and a bulk-action bar to send Intervene or Nudge to multiple learners at once; confirmations fire a success toast.
Removed the colored left accent bar from the Action Needed bucket cards on the OSHA Reports view.

Merged dashboard.html into index.html as a single-page shell and deleted dashboard.html. The sidebar's Dashboard, Reports, and OSHA Reports items now switch in-page views instead of navigating away: Dashboard (completions chart + feedback + inner tabs) and OSHA Reports are full views, and Reports embeds the standard SafeLMS reports design (../reports/) in an iframe for side-by-side comparison — so clicking Reports no longer leaves the product or loses access to the OSHA Reports tab. Views are hash-routed (#dashboard / #reports / #osha).

Reworked the OSHA report into a standalone page reached from the new OSHA Reports sidebar item (removed the Dashboard sub-tabs): Action Needed buckets (Intervene / Nudge / On Track / Done-Pass / Done-Fail), learner risk-distribution bar, expiring-certifications card, and a per-learner progress table filterable by bucket.
Moved the pencil banner out of the loading state to the top of the Report Log page (above the log table), shown each time the log opens; mirrored into the dev_handoff build.

Replaced the loading-state info banner with the new pencil-banner component (white card, blue left accent, info icon in a light-blue rounded square, dismiss-only) and updated its copy to "Only the Compliance and Completion reports are saved here while they generate. Refresh the page to see the latest updates."; mirrored into the dev_handoff build.
Rounded the filters and results table cards to 12px with no border and a soft shadow so they float as white cards on the gray canvas, matching the async-reports style.

Restyled the reports area and Report Log as floating white cards (rounded corners, soft shadow, no border) on a gray canvas, fixing the disconnected top-corner line on the log table; mirrored into the dev_handoff build.

Centered the "We'll email you when the report is ready" confirmation toast within the reports/main content area (offset by half the sidebar width) so the sidenav no longer makes it look off-center; mirrored into the dev_handoff build.

osha-report.title: OSHA Reporting
osha-report.description: OSHA course-completion reporting for SafeLMS, surfaced as a tab inside the Dashboard menu (next to Completions + Impact Insights), built on Convergence Report Redesign V1 (VRF) patterns. Completion Status Overview (distribution pie + Action Needed count cards for Not Started / Behind Schedule / Failed, each opening a course-filterable bulk-action modal), a per-course OSHA Completion Report table (course dropdown, Modules Complete X/10, status badges, sort, search, Time Spent, Failure/Retry, Certificate), and a right-side filter panel. Bottom version switcher toggles module-detail UX: V1 = per-student module progress + quiz-score modal, V2 = expand/collapse inline module quiz-score columns.

async-reports.description: Reports experience with asynchronous, background-generated exports and a Report Log (opened from a secondary button in the blue header) listing the four PRD target reports with CSV/Excel export and View Report actions.

LS integration warning.title: LS Integration Warning
LS integration warning.description: Learning Studio launch modal warning users they are creating an editable copy of a Vector course and are responsible for compliance. Includes a V1/V2 design switcher.

reports.description: SafeLMS reports landing page with training and course completion data tables.

test.description: Experimental scratch space for in-flight SafeLMS prototype work.

timeout modal SAFELMS-30656.description: Warning modal that prompts users when their session is about to expire.
